amala:
1amala
n. [S. lex. id.], talc; Abh 492 (~aṃ tv abbhakaṃ).
jālika:
1jālika
m. [ts], one who uses a net, a fisherman or bird-catcher; Abh 514; 670 (kevaṭṭajālikā).

2jālika
m (fn). [cf S. jālya?], what is liable to be caught in a net;? Sadd 787,.1 (jālena hato ~o suttena baddho suttiko).
jīraṇa:
1jīraṇa
n. [from jīrati1], growing old; decaying; wearing out; Abh 763 (~e jāni); Ja I 8,.30 (paribhogena °-bhāvo); Vism 527,.25 (~aṃ jarā); Ps II 170,.14 (~ato); Dhātup 252 (jara ~e); Dhātum 356; —      °-tā,   f., abstr., the state of being decayed or aged, old age, decay, decrepitude; M I 49,.21 (yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jarā ~ā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ …) = S II 2,.29; Dhs 644 (rūpassa jarā ~ā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ …); Pv-a 149,.9 (jarājīraṇatāya, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se jarājiṇṇatāya); —      ajīraṇa,   n., freedom from growing old, from decay; Spk I 93,.9 (ajarasā ti ~ena, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ajarena, prob. wr).

2jīraṇa
n. [from jīrati3], growing, increasing; Sadd 422,.32 (jīra brūhane: brūhanaṃ vaḍḍhanaṃ, jīrati … ~am).
kulāva:
kulava
kulāva1 m. or n. [cf kuṭava or kulāva2?], a receptacle; a shelter or store;? Vin II 292,.1 (sabbe v’ ime samaṇā … yoniso upanenti na ~aṃ gamenti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee kulāvaṃ; Sp 1297,.16 : na koṭṭhake gopentī ti adhippāyo).

2kulāva
n. [S. kulāya], a nest; Ja III 430,30* (ko me putte ~aṃ ca maṃ ca sotthiṃ karissati, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce, Se kulāvakaṃ); — see also vikulāva.

3kulāva
m. [?], a kind of bird; Ja VI 538,10* (kapiñjarā tittirāyo ~ā paṭikuttakā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be kulā ca; 538,31´ : ~ā paṭikuttakā ti ime dve pi sakuṇā).
pabbājaniya:
1pabbājanī̆ya
mfn., caus. fpp of pabbajati qv.

2pabbājanī̆ya
mfn. [cf pabbājana], concerning expulsion; (a formal act of the saṅgha) imposing (temporary) expulsion or banishment; Vin I 49,.29 (sace saṅgho upajjhāyassa kammaṃ kattukāmo hoti tajjaniyaṃ vā … ~aṃ vā …); Sp 1156,.16 (tajjanīyassa hi visesena bhaṇḍanakārakattaṃ aṅgaṃ … ~assa kuladūsakattaṃ vuttaṃ); —       °-kamma, n., an act of expulsion or banishment; Ja V 467,.16 (ahaṃ vā ito gehā nikkhamissāmi tava vā raṭṭhā ~aṃ karissāmī ti); VI 389,.25 (rājā tena hi mama vijite mā vasantū ti ~aṃ āṇāpesi); Mp II 318,.10 (pabbājanāyā ti gāmato vā raṭṭhato vā ~ena); — esp. a formal act of the saṅgha imposing (temporary) expulsion or banishment; Vin I 326,.1 (niyassakammārahassa ~aṃ karoti); III 183,.29 (bhikkhusaṅgho … Assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ Kiṭāgirismā ~aṃ akāsi na Assajipunabbasukehi bhikkhūhi Kiṭāgirismiṃ vatthabban ti); V 142,.4 (~assa … ko ādi kiṃ majjhe kiṃ pariyosānaṃ); A I 99,.6 (~aṃ paññattaṃ); Sp 1147,.11 (~ena hi vihārato nissāreti); — ~-kata, mfn., dealt with by a formal act of the saṅgha imposing (temporary) expulsion or banishment; Vin III 183,.31 (te saṅghena ~-katā na sammāvattanti …); Sp 624,.18.
paddha:
2paddha
mfn. [pa5 + addha1? or cf S. prādhva?], being a half;? on a journey;? Ja III 95,19* (tatth’ attani vata ppaddhe vinābhāve asaṃsaye bhūtaṃ sesaṃ dayitabbaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se vata ppanthe; 96,20´ : tasmiṃ vata evaṃ saramāne vaye ayaṃ attā ti saṅkhaṃ gato attabhāvo ~o hoti vayena aḍḍho upaḍḍho aparipuṇṇo va hoti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pantho hoti pāsena bandho upaḍḍho aparipuṇṇo va hoti).

3paddha
m. and mfn. [pa5 + addha(n)? cf S. lex. prādhva], 1. (m.) a road, a journey; — 2. (mfn.) humble; conforming;? Nidd II 193,.31 (na te Mārassa ~ā paddhacarā …, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se paṭṭhā paṭṭhacarā …); —      °-gū1, mfn. [paddha + gu1], going on the road, travelling; Ja III 95,17* (na h’ eva ṭhitaṃ nāsīnaṃ na sayānaṃ na ~uṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee p’ addhaguṃ; 96,12´ : samparivattetvā caramānaṃ); —       °-gū2, mfn. and m.f. [paddha + gu1], going in conformity, following; subservient to; a servant, an attendant;? S I 104,32* (na te Māravasānugā na te Mārassa ~ū, Ee baddhagū; Ee paccagū; Spk I 171,.10 : ~ū ti te tuyhaṃ Mārassa °-carā sissā antevāsikā na honti, Ee so; Be, Ce baddhagū ti … baddhacarā …; Se paccagū ti … bandhaparā …) ≠ Sn 1095 (Be, Ce, Ee so; Se paṭṭhagū; Pj II 597,.24 : ~ū ti te Mārassa °-carā paricārakā sissā na honti; = Nidd-a II 37,.7 : Be, Ce, Se so; Ee mārassa paṭṭhacarā paricārakā pesiyā na honti); Th 632 (yāhu raṭṭhe samukkaṭṭho rañño Aṅgassa ~ū, Be, Ce so; Ee ~u; Se patthagū; Th-a II 268,.22 : Aṅgādhipatino Bimbisārassa parivārabhūto gahapativiseso, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pakativiseso); Ja VI 380,18* (yo ve hadayassa ~ū, Ce, Ee so; Be pituhadayassa ~ū; Se patthagū; 380,22´ : ~ū ti pesanakārako, yo pitussa pesanaṃ karoti pitu cittassa vase vattati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se patthagū ti vacanakārako, yo me manaṃ karoti pitu cittassa vase vattati); —       °-cara, mfn. and m.f., acting in conformity; acting humbly or subserviently; a servant; Ja IV 35,21* (akāmikā ~ā ’mhi tuyhaṃ, Be so; Ce baddhacarāsmi; Ee baddha carāmi; Se paṭṭha carāmi; 35,29´ : veyyāvaccakārikā pādaparicārikā jātāmhī ti); VI 268,8* (Irandatī ~ā te hotu, Ce, Ee so; Be padacarā; Se pādacarā va; 268,9´ : ~ā ti pādaparicārikā, Ce, Ee so; Be padacarā ti; Se pādacarā vā ti); Ap 199,.3 (rañño ~o ahaṃ, Ee so; Be, Ce baddhacaro; Se paṭṭhacaro); Spk I 171,.11 (te tuyhaṃ Mārassa ~ā sissā antevāsikā na honti, Ee so; Be, Ce baddhacarā; Se bandhaparā); 212,.8 (~o ti antevāsiko, Ee so; Be, Ce baddhacaro; Se paṭacaro; ad S I 144,1* : Be, Ce, Ee baddhacaro; Se patacaro); — see also paṭṭha2.
pattha:
2paṭṭha
pattha1 n. (and mfn.?) [S. pṛṣṭha], 1. (n.) the back; the rear; — 2. (mfn.) being behind;? Nidd II 193,.31 (na te Mārassa ~ā paṭṭhacarā …, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce paddhā paddhacarā …); —      °-gū, mfn. and m.f. [paṭṭha + gu1; cf S. pṛṣṭhagāmi(n); see E.H. Johnston, 1931, pp. 586–87], following; a servant, an attendant; Sn 1095 (na te Māravasānugā na te Mārassa ~ū, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee paddhagū; ≠ S I 104,32* : Be, Ce baddhagū; Ee, Se paccagū); Th 632 (yāhu raṭṭhe samukkaṭṭho rañño Aṅgassa patthagū, Se so; Be, Ce paddhagū; Ee paddhagu; Th-a II 268,.22 foll.: Aṅgādhipatino Bimbisārassa paricārabhūto gahapativiseso, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pakativiseso); Ja VI 380,18* (yo ve hadayassa patthagū, Se so; Be pituhadayassa paddhagū; Ce, Ee paddhagū; 380,22´ : patthagū ti vacanakārako, yo me manaṃ karoti pitu cittassa vase vattati, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee paddhagū ti pesanakārako, yo pitussa pesanaṃ karoti pitu cittassa vase vattati); —       °-cara, mfn. and m.f., following; a servant; Nidd-a II 37,.8 (mārassa ~ā paricārakā pesiyā na honti, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se paddhacarā paricārakā sissā na honti; = Pj II 597,.25 : eds paddhacarā paricārakā sissā na honti); Ap 199,.3 (rañño ~o ahaṃ, Se so; Be, Ce baddhacaro; Ee paddhacaro; Ap-a 465,.31 : ~o ahan ti rañño paricārako kammakārako ahosin ti attho, Se so; Ee ~o āsin ti; Be baddhacaro; Ce baddhacaro āsin ti); — cf Ja IV 35,21* (akāmikā paṭṭha carāmi tuyhaṃ, Se so; Be paddhacarā ’mhi; Ce baddhacarā smi; Ee baddha carāmi; 35,29´ : veyyāvaccakārikā pādaparicārikā jātāmhī ti); —       °-bhūta, m (fn)., being behind, a follower, an attendant;? Ja V 6,13* (asaṃsayaṃ te jānanti ~ā yasassino, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee vaddhabhūtā; 7,9´ : ye pi tesaṃ ~ā yasassino paricārakā te pi jānanti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee vaddhabhūtā); — see also paddha3.

2pattha
m.n. and mfn. [S. prastha], 1. (m.n.) (i) a tableland; a level expanse; a remote or uncultivated place; Abh 607 (~o tu sānu nitthiyaṃ); 1044; — ifc see vana-; — patthā in Ee at Ja VI 558,31* is wr for panthā (Be, Ce, Se so); — (ii) a measure of capacity ( āḷhaka); Abh 482 (āḷhako caturo ~ā); 1044; Sp 176,.11 (~o nāma nāḷimattaṃ hoti ekassa purisassa alaṃ yāpanāya); Mp V 61,.21 foll. (Māgadhakena ~ena cattāro ~ā Kosalaraṭṭhe eko ~o hoti tena ~ena cattāro ~ā āḷhakaṃ); — 2. (mfn.) remote; secluded; Ud 43,8* (~aṃ ca sayanāsanaṃ, Ee, Se so, but perhaps wr; Be, Ce pantaṃ); —      °’-odana, m., a pattha of boiled rice; Vin III 243,.29 (omako nāma patto ~aṃ gaṇhāti; Sp 703,.21 : ~an ti Magadhanāḷiyā upaḍḍhanāḷikodanaṃ); Ja V 387,15* (~o nālam ayaṃ duvinnaṃ); Ap 376,.28 (ayaṃ ~o atthi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~aṃ); Ps III 238,.16 (tayo māse ~en’ eva yāpesi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee piṭṭhodaken’ eva); —       °-patthapulaka, n. [pulaka1], a pattha of parched grain each; Vin III 6,.22 foll. (tehi assamaṇḍalikāsu bhikkhūnaṃ ~aṃ paññattaṃ hoti, bhikkhū … ~aṃ ārāmaṃ haritvā udukkhale koṭṭetvā koṭṭetvā paribhuñjanti, Be, Ce so; Ee °-mūlakaṃ; Se °-pūlakaṃ; Sp 176,.11 : ~an ti ekamekassa bhikkhuno patthapatthapamāṇaṃ pulakaṃ); Dhp-a II 154,.2 (assavāṇijakā ~aṃ bhikkhaṃ paññāpesuṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee -mūlakaṃ; Se -pūlakaṃ); —       °-pulaka, n. [pattha + pulaka1], a pattha of parched grain; Vin III 6,.27 (āyasmā pan’ Ānando ~aṃ silāyaṃ pisitvā bhagavato upanāmeti, Be, Ce so; Ee -mūlakaṃ; Se -pūlakaṃ); Ja III 494,.28 (temāsaṃ ~-piṭṭhodakena yāpento, Be, Ce so; Ee patthamūlaka-; Se patthapūlakapatthodanena).
pavakkhati:
1pavakkhati
fut. 3 sg. [of pa5 + vacati; cf S. pravakti, vakṣyati], will declare, will expound, will tell; Vin I 99,3* (uddānaṃ anupubbaso ~āmi); D III 272,9* (dasuttaraṃ ~āmi dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā; Sv 1054,.32 : ~āmī ti kathessāmi); Sn 963 (taṃ te ~āmi yathā pajānaṃ; Nidd I 482,.7 : vakkhāmi ~āmi ācikkhissāmi desissāmi … pakāsissāmi); Ja V 324,6* (Nandassāpi nisāmetha vacanaṃ yaṃ ~ati); VI 532,5* (so te maggaṃ ~ati); Ap 47,.8 (atthaṃ tuyhaṃ ~āmi); Mhv 1:1 (mahāvaṃsaṃ ~āmi); — see also pavatta(r).

2pavakkhati
pr. 3 sg. [from pavakkhati1, interpreted as present], expounds, tells; — fut. 1 sg. pavakkhissaṃ, Cp p. 1,5* (imamhi kappe caritaṃ ~issaṃ suṇohi me; Cp-a 20,.25 : ~issan ti kathayissaṃ) quoted Sadd 337,.18 and 829,.17 foll. (atha vā pāḷinayena vacadhātussa vakkha icc ādeso hoti vā bhavissantīvibhattiyaṃ: vakkhissati icc ādi …).
ekacattāḷīsa:
eka
num. and mfn. [ts], (sg. nom. m. eko [and eke, eastern and/or heretical dialect], f. ekā, n. ekaṃ; acc. m.f.n. ekaṃ; instr. m.n. ekena, f. ekissā, ekāya; abl. m.n. ekasmā, ekamhā; dat./gen. m.n. ekassa, f. ekissā; loc. m.n. ekasmiṃ, ekamhi, f. ekissā, ekissaṃ, ekāya; — pl. nom. m. eke (and ekā? see Sadd 284,.3 foll. and 912,.33 foll. sv ekābhavati), f. ekā, n. ekāni; dat./gen. m. ekesaṃ; loc. m.n. ekesu; — see also Sadd 283,.19 foll.), one; Abh 850; Ud-a 18,.21 foll. ≠ Sadd 267,.8 foll.; — 1. (i) one; only one; a single; one of two or many; Vin I 92,.10 (dve bhikkhū … āvāsaṃ upagacchiṃsu … ~o bhikkhu gilāno hoti); 240,.13 (ekaṃ yeva sahassatthavikaṃ gahetvā); 317,.29 (~āya ñattiyā kammaṃ karoti); D I 166,.12 (~issā pi dattiyā yāpeti dvīhi pi dattīhi yāpeti …); II 48,.21 (~amhi vasse nikkhante); M I 64,.26 (~ā niṭṭhā udāhu puthū niṭṭhā ti); S I 86,.21 (atthi nu kho bhante ~o dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati); II 100,.29 (~issā pi bhante sattiyā haññamāno, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ekissa); A I 28,.2 (yaṃ ~issā lokadhātuyā ~o arahaṃ sammāsambuddho uppajjeyya ṭhānaṃ etaṃ vijjati); It 99,.1 (anussarati … ~aṃ pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo …); Pv 36:36 (~aṃ yugaṃ duve vā); Th 780 (~ena vatthena pahāya bhoge); Ja VI 66,25* (vivādamatto dutiyo ken’ ~o vivadissati); 536,15* (tīṇi kakkarujātāni … kumbhamattāni c’ ~āni murajamattāni tā ubho); Dhs 58 (~o phasso hoti ~ā vedanā hoti); Mil 192,.26 (~assa santike); Vism 279,.9 (~aṃ dve ti sakkharaṃ khipitvā khipitvā gaṇeti) = Sp 419,.25 (~o dve ti); Vism 566,.5 (nāpi ~amhā āyatanā sabbe phassā); Spk I 221,.7 foll. (~asmiṃ brahmacariyasmin ti ~āya dhammadesanāya); Mp I 94,.20 (~o ti dutiyādipaṭikkhepatthe gaṇanaparicchedo); Mhv 8:5 (~aṃ vassaṃ ayaṃ Laṅkādīpo āsi arājiko); — ekaṃ katvā, combining, making one; Sp 817,.22 (dve tīṇi nimantanāni ekapatte pakkhipitvā missetvā ~aṃ katvā bhuñjatī ti); Ps IV 94,.24; Mhv 9:27 (mātāmahassa nāmaṃ ca jeṭṭhassa mātulassa ca ~aṃ katvā); — one … another …; one … the other … : (a) eka … eka …: Abh 717; Vin I 9,.7 foll. (~o bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi ~o āsanaṃ paññāpesi ~o pādodakaṃ … upanikkhipi); 15,.3 (tayo pāsādā honti ~o hemantiko ~o gimhiko ~o vassiko); 46,.37 foll. (~ena hatthena pattaṃ gahetvā ~ena hatthena … parāmasitvā); D II 330,.27 foll. (~issā putto ahosi … ~ā gabbhinī); M I 25,.11 (dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ … ~o hīnapuriso akkhāyati ~o seṭṭhapuriso …); Ja VI 66,17* (yad ~aṃ cakkhuṃ niggayha jimhaṃ ~ena pekkhasi); Vism 200,.25 foll. (saṅkhāraviññāṇaṃ c’ ettha antarā ~o sandhi vedanātaṇhānaṃ antarā ~o bhavajātīnaṃ antarā ~o ti); (b) eka … dutiya …: Vin I 274,.10 (~ena passena satta māse nipajjitun ti … dutiyena passena satta māse nipajjitun ti); Ja II 165,27* (tesu ~o mato deva dutiyaṃ dehi khattiya); (c) eka … apara …: S I 17,.1 foll. (~ā devatā … aparā devatā …); (d) eka … añña …: Pv 26:6 (sāhunnavasanā ~e aññe kesanivāsanā); Ja IV 254,1* (yen’ eva ~o labhate pasaṃsaṃ ten’ eva añño labhate ninditāraṃ); — (ii) one only, one and the same; Vin I 21,.4 (mā ~ena dve agamittha); Sn 883 (kasmā na ~aṃ samaṇā vadanti); Ja I 165,.12 (sīho ca vyaggho ca … ~issā yeva guhāyaṃ vasanti); Mil 237,.6 foll. (sabbesaṃ pi tathāgatānaṃ ~ā desanā ~ā kathā ~ā sikkhā …); Mp I 71,.13 (ovādo ti vā anusāsanī ti vā ese ~e ekaṭṭhe same …) ≠ Spk II 254,29 = As 353,.10; Sadd 275,.1 (ese se ~e ekaṭṭhe ti pāḷippadese paccattekavacanakānaṃ etatasaddānaṃ ekārantaniddeso pi dissatī ti); — (iii) (indefinite:) one, a certain; a, an; Abh 717; Vin I 23,.14 (api bhante bhagavā ~aṃ itthiṃ passeyyā ti); M I 1,.4 (~aṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharati; Ps I 7,.31 : ~aṃ samayan ti aniyāmitaparidīpanaṃ); A II 169,.38 (amukasmiṃ nāma āvāse ~o thero bhikkhu viharati); Ja I 114,.17 (tesaṃ ~asmiṃ ṭhāne vasantānaṃ); 306,.27 (~asmiṃ hi samaye); III 171,.19 (~asmā gāmā manussā āgantvā); 507,.11 (~asmiṃ divase); IV 252,.4 (~en’ upāyena … dve kinnare gahetvā); Dhp-a I 46,.7 (~aṃ kulaṃ gantvā); III 346,.6 (so palāyanto ~issaṃ vaccakuṭiyaṃ pati); — 2. alone; solitary; Abh 718; Vin I 353,.6 (yannūnāhaṃ ~o va gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho vihareyyan ti); D II 203,.4 (~o raho anuvicintetvā); S I 130,10* (vanaṃ ajjhogatā ~ā purisaṃ nu gavesasi); A III 69,3* (na tv eva ~o ~āya mātugāmena sallape); Dhp 330 (~assa caritaṃ seyyo n’ atthi bāle sahāyatā); Sn 35 (na puttam iccheyya kuto sahāyaṃ ~o care khaggavisāṇakappo; Pj II 64,.2 foll. : ~o ti pabbajjā-saṅkhātena ~o adutiyaṭṭhena ~o taṇhāppahānena ~o ekantavigatakileso ti ~o ~o paccekasambodhiṃ abhisambuddho ti ~o); Th 538 (handa ~o gamissāmi araññaṃ); Ja IV 347,10* (~o va Indo asure jināti); V 363,12* (mā ~o vyasanaṃ agā; 363,15´ : mādise sevake vijjamāne mā ekako vyasanaṃ agā); Ud-a 163,.11 (~o ti asahāyo); — 3. one and only, unique; pre-eminent; Abh 696; Vin I 8,24* (ahaṃ satthā anuttaro ~o ’mhi sammāsambuddho); Vism 156,.23 (seṭṭho pi hi loke ~o ti vuccati); Ps I 229,.27 (~assā ti seṭṭhassa); — 4. all one; nothing but; D III 117,.16 (vadho yev’ ~o maññe Nigaṇṭhesu Nāṭaputtiyesu vattati, Se so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce, Ee yeva kho) = M II 244,.3 (Ee, Se so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce yeva kho); — see also iic; — 5. (pl.) some; some people; some authorities; Vin II 196,3* (daṇḍen’ ~e damayanti); D I 165,.32 (~esaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ); 181,.1 (sikkhā ~ā saññā uppajjanti); Dhp 126 (gabbhaṃ ~e upapajjanti); Sn 43 (dussaṅgahā pabbajitā pi ~e); Ja IV 338,10* (na santi devā icc āhu ~e; 338,17´ : ~e ti ekacce samaṇabrāhmaṇā); VI 285,4* (āmāyadāsā pi bhavanti h’ ~e); Sp 13,.2 (ākāsena gantvā nisīdī ti pi ~e); Ps I 227,.3 (katarasmiṃ jātake, Sutasomajātake ti ~e, ime pana therā Jayaddisajātake ti vadanti); Vv-a 246,.19 (~esu divasesu ayyā nāgamiṃsū ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee etesu); — iic : one …, a …; a single …; sole …, chief …; nothing but …, complete …; the same …, one and the same …; —       °’-aṃsa1,    m.
